title: The potential impact of fiscal rule changes on digital products trade
abstract: arXiv:2611.05714v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The WTO moratorium on customs duties on electronic transmissions lapsed in March 2026, allowing governments to impose tariffs on cross-border digital products, alongside other instruments such as digital services taxes (DSTs). Yet, how tariffs and DSTs compare in the revenue they raise and their effect on trade in digital products has not yet been assessed. Here we combine bilateral trade in 31 digital product categories in 2016-2024 with DST rates and tariffs on physical analogues, estimate gravity models and simulate alternative fiscal regimes. We find that digital trade is lower in destinations with a DST, but within destinations it declines only temporarily after adoption. In conditional scenarios for 2024 based on the event study estimate, adding tariff equivalents to DSTs raises revenue from USD 2.7 to 6.9 billion and lowers trade by about 1.4%, and replacing DSTs with tariff equivalents raises USD 4.3 billion. translated_title: 财政规则变化对数字产品贸易的潜在影响
translated_abstract: 世界贸易组织（WTO）对电子传输免征关税的暂停协议于2026年3月失效，这使得各国政府可以对跨境数字产品征收关税，同时也可采用数字服务税（DST）等其他政策工具。然而，关税与数字服务税在财政收入规模及其对数字产品贸易的影响方面孰优孰劣，此前尚未得到评估。本研究将2016至2024年间31类数字产品的双边贸易数据与数字服务税税率及实体类似产品的关税相结合，估计引力模型并模拟了不同的财政制度方案。研究发现，实施数字服务税的目的地数字贸易水平整体较低，但在政策实施之后，其境内数字贸易仅出现暂时性下降。基于事件研究估计构建的2024年条件情景显示，在数字服务税基础上叠加等效关税，可使相关财政收入从27亿美元提高至69亿美元，同时使贸易下降约1.4%；而以等效关税取代数字服务税则可带来43亿美元的收入。此外还发现……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究首次系统比较了WTO电子传输关税暂停失效后，关税与数字服务税对数字产品贸易和财政收入的影响，发现在数字服务税基础上叠加或以等效关税替代之可大幅增加财政收入，但会小幅抑制数字贸易。
en_tdlr: This study provides the first systematic comparison of tariffs versus digital services taxes (DSTs) on digital trade and fiscal revenue following the lapse of the WTO moratorium, showing that adding or replacing DSTs with tariff equivalents would substantially raise revenue while modestly reducing digital trade.
